title: Sell Mineral Rights in Sherrelwood, CO
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Sherrelwood, CO | Adams County
metaDescription: Unincorporated Sherrelwood in Adams County holds legacy DJ Basin mineral interests under dense mid-century subdivisions. Get a title-checked cash offer.
heroLead: Sherrelwood was farmland north of Denver before it was a subdivision, and the mineral certificate is often the only thing left connecting a family to that land.
intro: Sherrelwood is unincorporated Adams County, wedged between Westminster and Federal Heights, built out with single-family homes since the 1950s and 60s. Nobody is drilling a surface location here, but that doesn't mean the mineral interest under those lots is worthless.
Because Sherrelwood sits close to the Westminster city line, we also check whether any nearby municipal restrictions on new drilling affect the unit boundaries relevant to your tract.

sections.heading: Reach of horizontal units into built-out ground
paragraphs: Wattenberg Field laterals drilled from pads farther out in Weld or northern Adams County can, depending on section lines, be completed under neighborhoods like Sherrelwood without any surface disturbance locally. Whether your specific tract falls inside a current or likely future spacing unit is the first thing we check, using the legal description on your deed against active COGCC unit filings.

sections.heading: Adams County's cautious posture on new siting
paragraphs: Adams County has generally leaned toward more protective setback and siting rules for oil and gas near residential areas than Weld County has, which is one reason operators aim their longest laterals at farther-out sections rather than proposing new surface locations inside built-up Adams County subdivisions. That pushes activity outward but doesn't remove your mineral interest from being captured by a unit drilled from elsewhere.

sections.heading: What we need to quote your interest
paragraphs: A legal description or your mineral deed, and any division order or lease paperwork you still have. We confirm the chain through the Adams County Clerk and Recorder and check whether your tract sits inside an active spacing unit before making an offer.

faqs.question: Could a well ever be drilled under my Sherrelwood lot?
faqs.answer: Not a surface location, but a horizontal well bottomed under the tract from an outside pad is possible depending on unit geometry.

faqs.question: I inherited this mineral interest and have no paperwork. Now what?
faqs.answer: We can trace ownership through the Adams County recorder's office using the legal description of the original parcel.

faqs.question: Is Sherrelwood treated differently than Weld County ground?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, Adams County has taken a more cautious approach to new siting near residential areas, which affects timing but not necessarily long-term value.

faqs.question: Does Westminster's drilling policy affect Sherrelwood too?
faqs.answer: Only if your legal description falls inside Westminster's city limits. Unincorporated Sherrelwood itself follows Adams County's rules, which we confirm before valuing your interest.
